title: 661. Decode Ways II

examples.explanation: Any digit 1 through 9 forms one valid letter.
'1' pairs with each of the 9 options, and '11'..'19' are all valid pairs, giving 9 + 9.
9 single-step options plus the pairs '21'..'26' (6 options).

hints: Let dp[i] be the ways for the first i characters; each step adds single-character and two-character transitions.
A '*' alone contributes 9; as the second char of '1*' it contributes 9 pairs, of '2*' 6 pairs, and of '**' 15 pairs.
Take every addition modulo 1_000_000_007 and treat any chunk starting with '0' as invalid.
